roleContext.roleTitle: Senior Treasury Operations Analyst, Liquidity Reporting
roleContext.jobDescription: The liquidity reporting team produces the bank's daily liquidity position and the regulatory liquidity returns. The Senior Treasury Operations Analyst is the senior analyst of record on the daily position: signs the daily liquidity pack before it goes to the treasurer, supervises the two associate analysts who prepare it, owns the return reconciliation with finance, and documents the pack's boundaries. The team requires prior experience as the senior analyst signing a daily liquidity or funding pack, together with the treasury certification the bank's operations policy names. Reports to the head of liquidity reporting; works with the treasurer's office, finance and the regulatory reporting team.

requirements.text: Has been the senior analyst of record signing a daily liquidity or funding pack.
Holds the treasury certification named in the bank's operations policy.
Supervises the associate analysts who prepare the daily pack.
Reconciles the regulatory liquidity returns with finance under a documented reconciliation procedure.
Documents the daily pack's boundaries and open items for the treasurer.

candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Senior Treasury Operations Analyst, Liquidity Reporting

## Experience

- Senior Treasury Operations Analyst at a regional bank for three years, the senior analyst of record signing the daily liquidity pack before it went to the treasurer, after two years as an associate analyst preparing the same pack.
- Certified Treasury Professional since 2023; certificate number and the association's registry entry available on request.
- Supervised the two associate analysts who prepared the daily pack, running their preparation checklist and the four-eyes review before signing.
- Reconciled the regulatory liquidity returns with finance each month under the bank's reconciliation procedure, with the reconciliation workbooks filed in the treasury folder.
- Wrote the daily pack's boundary note and the open items list for the treasurer, updated after each month-end and each procedure change.

## Work samples

- Work sample: one signed daily liquidity pack with the boundary note and open items list, one monthly reconciliation workbook and the certification certificate, with the treasury folder references as a verification trail.
